articles.summary: Ask a practitioner where their hours actually go and the answer has been the same for decades: preparation, pulling evidence, tracing amounts, ticking and tying, formatting workpapers, chasing requests, building the file so that someone more senior can finally look at it. Review got whatever time was left over, because preparation was the job.
articles.title: Review Is the New Prepare: The Auditor's Job in an Agent-First World
